text: {"question": "What rare complication did the 29-year-old woman develop during the thyrotoxic phase of subacute thyroiditis?", "answer": "The patient developed intracranial hypertension as a complication during the thyrotoxic phase of subacute thyroiditis, presenting with symptoms such as headache, nausea, vomiting, fever, and later bilateral visual blurring and pulsatile tinnitus.", "evidence": "We report the case of a 29-year-old woman who developed IH during the thyrotoxic phase of subacute thyroiditis, temporally related to dental manipulation."}
